item.description:
AgentsEye 0.17.13 makes Claude reconnection clear and browser-neutral.
- Removes browser-brand implementation details from the Claude reconnect flow. - Opens Claude's own usage page in the user's default browser. - Explains the connection in terms of Claude Code and claude.ai instead of a specific browser. - Keeps the local browser-session fallback and privacy protections introduced in 0.17.12.

AgentsEye 0.17.12 makes Claude subscription usage recoverable when Claude Code OAuth cannot provide quota.
- Adds a local Zen and Firefox session fallback for Claude's 5-hour and weekly quota windows. - Keeps Claude credentials on the Mac and sends them only to Claude's own organization and usage endpoints. - Never stores or logs the imported browser session. - Adds a direct Open Claude usage recovery action when the browser session has expired. - Keeps local Claude token and session history available when no live subscription quota exists.

AgentsEye 0.17.11 keeps the selected provider visible when following active usage.
- The menu bar now retains the last confirmed provider while you are idle instead of reverting to a generic bars icon and dash. - New activity still switches the menu bar automatically to the provider you are using. - Before the first activity signal, AgentsEye shows a real available quota rather than an empty placeholder. - The menu and settings describe idle state honestly as the last used provider while waiting for new activity.
